reviewSamples.author: Photo of Rohita Love
reviewSamples.text: I couldn't be happier with my experience with Kathleen! I chose her to be my prenatal massage therapist throughout my pregnancy journey, and she has been taking wonderful care of me for months now. She truly understands how to work with a pregnant woman's body and takes every precaution to make sure I feel safe, comfortable, and completely relaxed throughout each session.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Jeremy Fulco
reviewSamples.text: Catleen is amazing! She does amazing deep tissue massages and helps me recover from sports related injuries. I always feel more flexible, less stressed and lighter after each session.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Erin Fulco
reviewSamples.text: So glad we found Catleen! Having her come to our home is incredibly convenient, but it's her skill and genuine care that makes us repeat clients. We've noticed a real difference in our mobility, muscle tension, and overall well-being because of her treatments.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Joshua Shapiro
reviewSamples.text: I thought I knew what a good deep tissue massage was until I met Kat. She is absolutely incredible, meticulous and really focuses on your body. I like to call her a healer.
